FighterRequest.description: One side of the matchup, as understood from the user's words.

entity.description: Normalized name of the fighter, e.g. "grizzly bear".
entity.title: Entity

count.description: How many of them fight on this side (1 to 10,000).
count.title: Count

variant.description: Which kind, e.g. "adult male" or "polar"; empty when not specified.
variant.title: Variant

size_reference.description:
Another entity this fighter is sized like ("horse-sized duck" -> "horse"). Only a name,
never a number: code computes the scale factor from both stat sheets' mass_kg.
size_reference.title: Size Reference

raw.description: The user's own words for this fighter.
raw.title: Raw

FighterRequest.title: FighterRequest

Matchup.description: A parsed battle request: exactly two sides on one terrain.

fighters.description: The two sides (the MVP supports exactly two).
fighters.title: Fighters

terrain.description: Where they fight; the arena when the user didn't say.

raw_text.description: The user's full request, word for word.
raw_text.title: Raw Text

assumptions.description: Choices intake made for the user, e.g. "Assumed adult male grizzly".
assumptions.title: Assumptions

Matchup.title: Matchup

Terrain.description: The battlefield; it changes who can reach whom and how fast they move.
Terrain.title: Terrain

description: Intake's answer: a matchup, a clarifying question, or a block.

status.description: ok = ready to research; clarify = ask the user first; blocked = refused.
status.title: Status

matchup.description: The parsed matchup when status is ok.

question.description: The clarifying question when status is clarify.
question.title: Question

options.description: Two to four suggested answers to the question.
options.title: Options

pending_id.description: Id to send back with the user's answer to a clarifying question.
pending_id.title: Pending Id

blocked_reason.description:
Why the request was refused. deity = named gods or religious figures; weapon = modern
firearms, explosives, WMD; out_of_scope = abstract ideas, places, landforms,
celestial bodies.
blocked_reason.title: Blocked Reason

message.description: Friendly text shown to the user.
message.title: Message

title: IntakeResult
